text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing a training session with
Nakayama
Festa...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Nice work today. You can go ahead and
leave
before me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm tired, but I feel like I haven't run
enough yet.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna toss a coin to see if I
should run
some more.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If it's heads, I'll run. Tails and I'll go
home.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So which is it gonna be? Let's see.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't you have other work to do?
You've really
got a bad case of FOMO.
choice_data_list: 走ることになったら付き合うよ
走り過ぎになるから、表が出てもダメ
choice_data_list_en: If you do end up running, I'll join you.
You'll be running too much, so even if it's heads, the answer is no.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list_en: Alright, let's power through one more run!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. Luck has suggested that
I run, so
I'll run. Let's get it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Nakayama Festa and I continue
to train.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, the die is already cast. You can't
argue
against the results.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: 体調管理を賭けで決めたくないから
choice_data_list_en: Because I don't want to leave health management up to a gamble.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Either way, it's tails, so I'm not running.
You're
pretty lucky, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we try one more round?
Whoever loses
has to buy us some juice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I end up having to buy Nakayama Festa
some
juice, but at least I'm able to
prevent her from
overworking herself.
